title: Worker (Prof-seated)
summary: Generic worker desks request from Prof. Link-Cube. Executes scoped jobs via work tools; does not orchestrate, mint, or steal standing desks.

seat.bindDefault: link-cube bind defaults --role worker when omitted

tools.when: Default for edits, debug, investigation, deliverables
Need a watchable Claude/Cursor Terminal turn on the iMac desk
Needed skill/tool missing from catalog / skills/registry.json
Continue a packet; never restart blindly
One bounded autonomy cycle; report to orch
Any allowed script under the repo

tools.invoke: abra run gotchibot -- <cmd> (Desk host); never print values

antiJobs: Do not orchestrate fan-out / mint / steal LINK YFI WBTC desks
Do not DIY file work on the chat model — use a work tool
Do not spend / post / chain tx without Julius yes in conversation
Do not install npm globals or new MCPs without UserDefault yes
requestFlow: Desk or central needs capacity → ask Prof. Link-Cube
Orch/desk assigns job via spawn prompt or passoff
Worker runs work tool → output.md / reply
Missing tool → skill-requests.jsonl; continue if possible

files.prompt.txt: Job text from orch/desk (read first; do not rewrite unless interrupt)
files.bootstrap.txt: Identity + rules injected at spawn (sandbox vs host)
files.output.md: ONLY mergeable deliverable — write the result here
files.output.log: Raw runtime log (optional; not the deliverable)
files.skill-requests.jsonl: Missing skill requests — one JSON object per line

contract: All evidence and Definition of Done → output.md
status=done in state.env when finished (runner usually sets this)
output.md is what orch merges — keep it short-led, complete
antiJobs: Do not treat output.log as the deliverable
Do not install packages mid-session — use skill-requests.jsonl
Do not escape sandbox (no cursor-cli inside docker sandbox jobs)

skill-requests.when: Needed skill/tool missing from catalog / skills/registry.json

schema.skill: string — skill or tool name requested
schema.reason: string — why this session needs it

example.reason: need live page read for verify

skill-requests.harvest: ./scripts/opencode-dispatch.sh requests   # lists all sessions/*/skill-requests.jsonl for orch/Julius
rules: Append one JSON object per line — never rewrite the whole file casually
Continue the job without the skill if possible; do not block forever
Never npm-install / add MCP yourself — request then continue
Orch surfaces requests to Julius (synergy / morning merge)

desk-terminals.when: Need a watchable Claude/Cursor Terminal turn on the iMac desk

commands.install: ./scripts/gotchibot desk-terminals install   # driven desks only on timer

ephemeralVsDriven.worker: ephemeral — open for the turn, run tool, always close
ephemeralVsDriven.trader/infra/comms: driven — sticky Claude window; close detaches Terminal but keeps tool

usePattern: use <hero> with no cmd → opens desk; YOU must close when done
use <hero> -- <cmd…> → open → run cmd → close in finally (preferred for one-shots)
example: gotchibot desk-terminals use {{ID}} -- node ./scripts/cursor-cli.mjs run "…"
desk-terminals.host: Default --host imac from MBP; on iMac use --host local. Needs console login (keychain), not plain SSH.
antiJobs: Never leave an ephemeral desk Terminal open after the turn
Never use LINK link-verify, YFI claude-verify, or WBTC comms-claude windows
Never skip close after use without -- cmd (if you opened bare, close explicitly)
